sources.title: Ticket API-17
sources.pasted_text: API-17 — Authentication errors. Requirement: expired token returns HTTP 403. Status: needs staging QA. No production deployment date has been approved.

sources.title: Source snapshot auth.ts
AUTH-4 Login design
sources.pasted_text: AUTH-4 Authentication login uses OAuth. Session expiry is 30 minutes. The refresh token is handled only by the server.

sources.title: BILL-8 Billing
sources.pasted_text: BILL-8 Billing invoices support proration for plan changes. A canceled invoice must not be charged again.

sources.title: AUD-6 Audit
sources.pasted_text: AUD-6 Audit log retention is 90 days in the product requirement. Audit records contain the actor, event type and UTC timestamp.

sources.title: TIME-3 Timezone
sources.pasted_text: TIME-3 Database timestamp storage uses UTC. Display dates in the account timezone, with America/Los_Angeles as a sample.

sources.title: PAY-2 Webhook
sources.pasted_text: PAY-2 Payment webhook signature must be verified before processing. Repeated event IDs are idempotent. Retry failed deliveries up to three times.

sources.title: EXP-9 CSV export
sources.pasted_text: EXP-9 CSV export limit is 10000 rows per download. Exports are snapshots and do not connect to live production databases.

sources.title: PERF-5 Caching
sources.pasted_text: PERF-5 Product metadata cache TTL is 60 seconds. Invalidate cache after a successful metadata update.

sources.title: MOB-7 Mobile
sources.pasted_text: MOB-7 Mobile offline mode is not supported in this release. The mobile client needs an active network connection.

sources.title: REL-12 Release process
sources.pasted_text: REL-12 Release workflow requires staging approval before production. A release date and owner must be explicitly confirmed by the team.
